decision.name: Dependency-scoped expense locking with explicit whole-group closeout

dependency_scoped.description: An active nonterminal settlement locks only mutations that would change source truth already frozen into that settlement.
dependency_scoped.create: Allow a new unrelated Expense because an exact prepared SettlementScope does not retroactively expand to include new ledger items.
dependency_scoped.edit: Block when the target Expense is in the active SettlementScope source_item_ids; otherwise allow.
dependency_scoped.delete: Block when the target Expense is in the active SettlementScope source_item_ids; otherwise allow.

group_closeout.description: A user deliberately starts a whole-group closeout. The active scope freezes the relevant Group ledger while that closeout remains nonterminal.
group_closeout.edit: Block for Expenses in the closeout Group.
group_closeout.delete: Block for Expenses in the closeout Group.

decision.unknown_effect_rule: If execution outcome may have taken effect but is not yet known, keep the relevant active SettlementScope locked until the original PaymentIntent is reconciled.
decision.exact_scope_rule: SettlementScope is frozen before authorization. Later unrelated Expenses create new ledger truth; they do not silently change the already-prepared PaymentIntent.
decision.release_rule: Release the lock only when the owning PaymentIntent becomes terminal, is explicitly cancelled before effect, or reconciliation establishes a safe no-effect/terminal result.
decision.explanation_rule: The product should be able to explain which active settlement causes a mutation to be blocked.

rationale: The historical Goldens establish settlement-related Expense locking but do not settle group-wide versus item-scoped integration behavior.
Later settlement contracts make source lineage exact and dependency-aware.
Dependency-scoped locking preserves safety without unnecessarily freezing unrelated group activity.
An explicit whole-group closeout legitimately broadens the same mechanism instead of creating a second locking system.
authority_note: This record is a new human product decision made after the frozen Golden baseline. It does not claim to have been implied by the historical Goldens.
